the fork's Timeline Fade rows (v34-startup-videos-3, read after every client Update): start to menu None>FadingOut at LoadMenu>StopLoading, FadingOut>FadingIn in the tick of StopLoading>Menu, FadingIn>None 1.0 s later; a level start and a save load (checkpoint+reset) the same around Running>StartLoading and PrepareRunning>Running; four far camera focuses (GK.Camera.Focus past 50 m, faded=true from the HUD's ScreenFade widget) moved it not at all, so the camera's fade is another mechanism
